subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct option to fill in blank number 4 is **"toll".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence mentions the number of deaths caused by the Nipah virus infection, which has increased to 12 with the recent death of V Moosa.
 
• The word that fits grammatically and semantically in this context is "**toll**", which means** the number of deaths or casualties caused by a particular event or circumstance**.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read as "With this, the death toll due to the virus infection has gone up to 12."
